problem.statement: Garnet must close the finite S114 governance arc with fail-closed, squash-durable review evidence and a human-controlled activation boundary before the governance freeze can arm.
successCriteria: Rolling review binds exact touched paths, content digests, and reviewer identity and returns RED on every enumeration failure
GOV-009 proves fresh exact-reviewed-head and outcome-verified state while the live no-bypass clause remains explicitly blocked unless Jon provides a dedicated admin-authoritative token
Every external workflow action is pinned to a full immutable SHA and governance transport scripts enter the Jon-only exception boundary
The four policy suites agree across Linux, macOS, and Windows and fail closed on malformed or unreadable inputs
The human 31-to-32 ceremony package and S114 terminus note are prepared without activating, merging, publishing, tagging, or firing

definitionOfDone.claim: the rolling review gate fails closed on every enumeration failure
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: inject each failure mode — unreachable API, truncated page set, malformed reviewer identity, digest mismatch, empty path list, partial pagination — and assert RED for each; any warn-then-green falsifies

definitionOfDone.claim: zero mutable external action references remain
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: enumerate every uses: in .github/workflows; any reference not pinned to a full 40-char SHA falsifies

definitionOfDone.claim: all four policy suites return identical results on Linux, macOS, and Windows
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: run the four suites from the base on all three OSes; any divergence in outcome falsifies

definitionOfDone.claim: the 32nd required context is authenticated, semantic, base-controlled, and cannot be bypassed
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: live readback with an admin-authoritative token must show the context required and bypass_actors empty; a 403/null read, an inherited credential, or a non-empty bypass list falsifies

definitionOfDone.claim: every review marker remains valid after Garnet squash-merges its reviewed branch
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: a marker that requires the pre-squash reviewed head to be an ancestor of main, lacks a reviewed tree digest, or lacks a landed commit on upstream main first-parent history falsifies

definitionOfDone.claim: the governance freeze arms only from the human-merged terminus artifact
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: any agent merge, activation, FIRE, tag, publish, or claim that the freeze is active before the terminus lands falsifies

confidence.biggestRisk: A structurally green policy could still fail open when its own GitHub enumeration or provenance inputs are incomplete.
confidence.nextAction: Record the base RED and implement rolling-review v2 failure semantics before any later Lane 1 item.

rejectedAlternatives.idea: Treat a warning or unavailable enumeration as sufficient review evidence
rejectedAlternatives.reason: That recreates U-04 by allowing the gate to approve the exact condition it failed to enumerate.

rejectedAlternatives.idea: Use an ambient or fork credential for the live no-bypass readback
rejectedAlternatives.reason: U-17 requires an explicitly provisioned admin-authoritative token that is never inherited, persisted, or printed.
